summary: NHTSA declined to incorporate manufacturers' comments on the impossibility of weight reduction, noting that the weight reduction scenario applied only to GM and that GM had not claimed it was impossible.
text: The manufacturers' comments on the impossibility of weight reduction are not incorporated because the application of weight reduction is only to GM and they did not say it was impossible. The discussion of sulfate emissions has been dropped and the discussion of noble metal use has been revised to indicate a smaller increase in the use of platinum and palladium. Minor changes have been made to the sections on noise emissions and increased use of plastics.
